title: Lovely Crispy Fried Argentinian Duck Empanada
description: A crispy fried empanada filled with roasted duck, perfect for a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: Roasted Duck Breast
ingredients.notes: Cooked in duck fat at 275°F for 30 minutes

ingredients.name: Chimichurri
ingredients.notes: An Argentinian herb and vinegar sauce

instructions: Roll out the puff pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Spoon a tablespoon of roasted duck breast onto one half of each dough circle.
Drizzle a small amount of chimichurri sauce on top of the duck breast.
Brush the edges of the dough with a little water and fold the other half of the dough over the filling to form a half-circle.
Press the edges with a fork to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little duck fat and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the empanadas hot in copper mugs with additional chimichurri sauce for dipping.
